thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD3001 fired -> inference.queue.latency > 120s (cell: us-west-2, pool: inference-hot). triggering automated page :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PD3001 -> fired for service: inference-queue (severity: P1)

ida (on-call): acked PD3001, I'm on it. grabbing current dashboard.

sam (eng-sre): seeing a sharp spike in queue length and scale-controller not spinning up new nodes fast enough. autoscaler logs show provisioning stalls.

nina (eng-runtime): looking at scale-controller logs: `ErrQuota: InsufficientQuota: requests could not be scheduled` around 1792233420. Cloud API is rejecting spot allocations.

mike (eng-oncall): customer-facing metric: request latency p95 -> 3200ms, errors -> 4.8% 503s over last 5m. tagging that as potential customer impact.

ida (on-call): can we manually force a warmup/reserve to get through the spike? prefer minimal change to avoid cascading.

sam (eng-sre): prepared commands if we need manual scale. will coordinate with admissions: 
```
# manual scale to mitigate immediate backlog
redwoodctl fleet resize --pool inference-hot --nodes 8 --region us-west-2
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/autoscaler --replicas=8
```

nina (eng-runtime): adding context: autoscaler is configured to use spot + on-demand mix. spot requests are being rate-limited by provider, so autoscaler backoff is long. we'll need to bump on-demand fallback or route traffic to dedicated pool.

mike (eng-oncall): trying `redwoodctl` now...

ops-bot: Command executed by mike: `redwoodctl fleet resize --pool inference-hot --nodes 8 --region us-west-2` -> accepted, starting instance provisioning. (note: this is a simulated log in slack thread)

sam (eng-sre): also propose enabling model-fallback routing to a smaller (half-size) model to keep latency down while capacity catches up. Nina, can you flip the routing rule?

nina (eng-runtime): yes. flipping canary routing to fallback-model-v1 for the overflow route. Will keep 10% traffic for primary while we heal.

ida (on-call): applied temporary rate limit to batch endpoints to protect control plane: `rate-limit: 50rps` on /v1/generate-batch.

sam (eng-sre): checking autoscaler metrics: node provisioning started at 1792233465. ETA ~80s. queue drain rate improved slightly.

mike (eng-oncall): from logs: `scale-controller: provision request accepted, instanceIDs=[i-0abc..., i-0def...]` but cloud shows some delayed attachments.

ops-bot: cloud provider event: "SpotInstancePoolExhausted" for us-west-2, launching fallback on-demand.

ida (on-call): customer impact update: small subset of customers on heavy-batch pipelines seeing 5xx / timeouts; estimated affected requests ~3-6% of total. Notified support to mark incident in status page.

sre-lead: escalate to infra for quota increase request if this pattern repeats. For now manual on-demand falls back.

sam (eng-sre): suggestion: reduce max batch size temporarily (from 64 -> 32) to lower per-request scheduling pressure. Nina, want me to patch the config?

nina (eng-runtime): go ahead, patching configmap `inference-config` now. diff: `batch.max_size: 64 -> 32` will roll out to fleet incrementally.

ida (on-call): PagerDuty note: ack by ida at 1792233450. Escalation to sre-lead at 1792233500.

mike (eng-oncall): manual scale step resulted in additional nodes becoming Ready at 1792233520. queue length decreasing. p95 down to 900ms. errors trending down.

sam (eng-sre): running a quick post-mortem checklist in thread: 1) root cause = spot pool exhaustion + long autoscaler backoff, 2) mitigation = manual on-demand resize + fallback model routing + batch size reduction, 3) customer impact = transient increased 5xxs for small % of requests.

ida (on-call): will keep monitoring for next 30m. if stable, will close PD and update status page.

incident-bot: PD3001 acknowledged at 1792233450 by ida (on-call). PD3001 status: acknowledged -> resolved pending confirmation.

pagerduty: PD3001 -> resolved by ida (on-call) at 1792233570 :white_check_mark:

ida (on-call): closing notes: follow-up actions assigned: (sam) request quota increase and audit spot fallback thresholds, (nina) add a shorter backoff path in autoscaler for spot failures, (mike) add runbook entry for manual warmup and `redwoodctl` steps. I'll file the incident report and link to this thread. :thumbsup:
